scientific_integrity: The independent rotated-coordinate beta law is credited to Smith et al. (2022); novelty is asserted only for the strict all-parameter fourth-angle harmonic ordering and resulting inverse calibration. The limit-law and exact anchor follow from the new proof. No independent scientific audit or publication-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Athermal four-orientation planar harmonic trap only; no translational Brownian noise, higher angle harmonics, arbitrary turning laws, finite-sample inference or separate identification of gamma and mu. Strict ordering is a mathematical theorem in the stated model, not a universal active-matter assertion.
title: Strict angular anisotropy calibration for a quarter-turn swimmer in a harmonic trap
